teaser: "You always seem so sure of yourself," someone says at the end of a long conversation, not knowing how much of it you spent reading them instead of talking about yourself. Life path 7 and ENFJ sit at an angle to each other. The 7 wants a locked door and a long quiet; ENFJ senses what a room needs on instinct and wants to walk through that door to help. What is particular to this crossing is the double life it produces: the person everyone comes to, who also needs, more than most of the people who come to them, to disappear for a while.
excerpt: The sign out front of the diner is missing a letter, has been for years, and the booth by the window is the one you always take when it is just the two of you after closing.
